---
name: mtb-generated-source-protection
description: Prevents direct modification of Device Configurator output files. These files are auto-generated and must only be changed through the Device Configurator GUI.
applyTo: "**/**design.modus,**/GeneratedSource"
---

# ⛔ DO NOT MODIFY DIRECTLY

These files are generated by **Device Configurator** and must never be edited by hand or by an agent.

To change peripheral configuration, pin assignments, clock settings, or any hardware parameter:

1. Open the `mtb-device-configurator` skill
2. Follow the workflow to present instructions to the user
3. The user will make changes in the Device Configurator GUI
4. The tool regenerates these files automatically on save

**Direct edits will be overwritten** the next time Device Configurator saves.
